request.description: Lead intake for websites, landing pages and partner systems, authenticated with an API key (`X-Api-Key`) that has the `leads:create` scope and is linked to a lead source. Rate limited per key. Send `externalRef` (your own id) to make retries safe: a repeat returns 200 with `replayed: true` and the original lead. Consent captured on the form is sent as `consent.items` with the `templateVersionId` of the consent text shown; without it the lead waits in the consent queue. At least one valid mobile, landline or email is required; an invalid extra number is kept as the `invalid_number` flag. The person is matched by contact (same contact and a compatible name links to the same person; a different name on the same contact opens a review). `category` may be a key or an alias, and `city` free text is resolved through aliases; anything unrecognised is kept and flagged (`unmapped_category`, `unmapped_location`). `amountText` such as "20-25 lakh" or "upto 1 cr" is parsed into paise. A repeat open enquiry for the same person and category within 30 days is flagged `duplicate`. `answers` go through the lead-capture questionnaire for the source and become declared facts. The original payload is stored encrypted.
